annotations.title: Register a Sign in with Chain Daddy client

description:
Register a sign-in client

Registers a site or app that can send people to Sign in with Chain Daddy. Needs Developer Beta Program membership (the current agreement signed); registering is free.

- `redirectUris`: 1 to 10, matched exactly (no wildcards, no fragments, no credentials). `https` only, except `http://localhost` and `http://127.0.0.1` for development.
- `confidential: true` is for a server that can keep a secret: the response carries `clientSecret` (`cd_oauth_` + 64 hex) once, and it is not shown again and cannot be rotated here. `false` suits a single-page app, a game or a native app, which use PKCE with no secret.
- `name`: 1 to 40 characters; it may not contain "Chain Daddy", "official", "support" or "wallet" (checked ignoring case, spaces and punctuation).
- `crown` (optional): a token page the caller holds or manages. It earns the consent screen's Verified mark for redirect hosts on that page's DNS-verified domains; without it the screen says "Unverified site".

Needs Sign in with Chain Daddy, allowing changes (scope api:write).
name: create_oauth_client

clientSecret.description: `cd_oauth_` + 64 hex. Only in the create response, and only for a confidential client.

secretPrefix.description: First characters of a confidential client's secret (`cd_oauth_` + 6)

suspended.description: Support turned the client off; it signs nobody in until support lifts it

verifiedHosts.description: Redirect hosts the consent screen marks Verified right now
